senses.gloss: (cmp. יָגָה a. יָגוֹן) to cut, grieve, pain.
to shape, handle, esp. to straighten an infant’s body by manipulation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:6">Sabb. XXII, 6</cite> <he>אין מְעַצְּבִין את הקטן</he> you must not manipulate a child (on the Sabbath), expl. ib. 147ᵇ <he>בחומרי שדרה</he> straightening the vertebra (v. <cite ref="L00647"><he>לְפַף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 9</cite> <he>שהוא מְעַצֵּב עליה וכ׳</he> because he (the surgeon) manipulates children thereon.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:9">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 139:24">Ps. CXXXIX, 24</cite>) <he>אם עתיד …</he> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>להַעֲצִיבְךָ וכ׳</he> if it be my destiny to rear children who are to grieve thee, it is better that thou shouldst lead me in the way of the world (death); (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 888:8">Yalk. Ps. 888</cite> <he>ולהכעיסך</he>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>שמח בתורתו ונ׳ במיתתו</he> he rejoiced over his (R. ‘Ăkiba’s) learning, and mourned over his death (predestined martyrdom).
